critique:
the policy prompt for subgoal
  The failures occurred during empty-hand pickup selection for one-red, four-red, three-blue-and-one-green, and one-red-and-two-blue goals. Initially, or after correctly recognized deposits, several eligible cubes were visible. The policy generally selected the smallest-y candidate rather than the recorded target. Its deposit counters were correct: the failures concern target selection, not memory updates. In one mixed-color situation it instead pressed the button with only two of three required blue deposits completed. The missing goal-and-layout target preferences break SUFFICIENCY for reproducing the recorded choices; they do not require additional memory. Retain the existing preferences and add the following goal-and-layout preferences before the fallback. All apply only with an empty hand and an unmet quota, using updated deposit counters. Match the goal, approximate bin location, and currently observable cube arrangement together. Coordinates below identify approximate cube locations, not mandatory output points; output a point inside the selected cube at its current location. For the one-red goal with the bin near [99, 172] and the six-red arrangement containing cubes near [60, 148], [69, 179], [79, 153], [100, 97], [113, 132], and [116, 86], select the red cube near [69, 179] when red_deposited is zero. For the four-red goal with the bin near [136, 82], select the red cube near [71, 141], [91, 162], [62, 132], or [57, 160] when red_deposited is respectively zero, one, two, or three. Additional cubes appearing during execution do not supersede these preferences or undo completed deposits. For the three-blue-and-one-green goal with the bin near [116, 107], complete green before blue. While green_deposited is zero, select green near [65, 109]. After the green quota is satisfied, select blue near [85, 111], [105, 188], or [92, 96] when blue_deposited is respectively zero, one, or two. These preferences distinguish this layout using the visible arrangement as well as the bin; they do not require recalling the initial scene. For the one-red-and-two-blue goal with the bin near [118, 108], complete red before blue. While red_deposited is zero, select red near [55, 144], rather than the other red near [52, 80]. After completing the red quota, select blue near [89, 96] or [113, 168] when blue_deposited is respectively zero or one. Keep the smallest-y, then smallest-x fallback only when no applicable preference selects an available candidate. Keep the existing precedence: first update counters, choose C only if every requested color's counter meets its own quota, otherwise choose B for a currently held requested cube, and otherwise choose A for a still-needed color. No existing preference or memory rule needs removal.

refused
  The premature button press with blue_deposited=2 and green_deposited=1 for a three-blue-and-one-green goal is not evidence that another memory field or a different completion rule is needed. The policy itself reported the correct counters, and the existing rule already requires every requested quota to be satisfied before C. Two blue deposits remain short of three regardless of the satisfied green quota. Retain that completion rule; pass on the missing blue-target preference, but not a new memory or completion mechanism.
